test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 01 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
What would be the symbol on the opposite side of '≠' if the given sheet is folded to form a cube?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d70551dc8088787b028b2dab0ee97c99c08e4a5c704613df3ae700d8eb2e94c.png]
solution:
Opposite surface of the open dice can be found by the below methods: -

 
• **Alternate surfaces are opposite to each other.**
 
• **No two opposite surface are touched by side or by corners.**

So, by using the above rule we can find the opposite surface of open dice.

Below are the opposite surfaces: -

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a40c6b7edddd9c931a1cea2f923500b90385b2953ae3b95289091c18c57959a5.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0fe2a34f259e82df5c5673c9e6251e362198d649f53cc9910258cd4bbd8ac22e.png] 

Here, we can see that the symbol on the opposite side of '≠' is '%'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"%"**.
